goal: Preserve whole-stream trend and uncertainty; use SG047 change point solely as a challenge rather than replacing full history.

frozen_rules.whole_history: Use SG047 globally split calibrated full240 HAC slope interval with multiplier 2.291027529910169
frozen_rules.boundary_detection: SG047 frozen scan candidates [60,80,100,120,140,160,180], score |delta_AR1|+.35|log(RMS_after/RMS_before)|, alarm if score>.5186019321426611
frozen_rules.post_boundary: When alarmed, compute post-boundary HAC slope interval with SG047 multiplier 5.346129511387088, but never replace full-history interval or slope.
frozen_rules.conflict: If full-history classification is confirmed/rejected AND post-boundary classification is the opposing non-unresolved label, change decision to unresolved. Local unresolved or same labels leave full-history decision unchanged. No data discarded.
frozen_rules.classify: Interval entirely above/below zero -> confirmed; otherwise interval entirely in (-.0032,.0032) -> rejected; otherwise unresolved

disclosed_pilot.notes: One formerly correct pooled decision withheld, no wrong prevented. Negative pilot preserved. SG048 still less cautious than SG046.

limitations: All policies retrospective full240, not online.
One local interval and one full interval share data, so conflict not independent source evidence.
A warning-only approach can keep confident false decisions when local comparator abstains.
Split calibration pooled and on synthetic data does not guarantee worst-regime coverage.
